import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' column to datetime
data['date'] = pd.to_datetime(data['date'])

# Set the style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axis
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 6))

# Plot: Total sales per product over time
sales_over_time = data.groupby(['date', 'product'])['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Line plot with hue for different products
sns.lineplot(data=sales_over_time, x='date', y='total', hue='product', marker='o', ax=ax)

# Set labels and title
ax.set_title('Total Sales per Product Over Time', fontsize=14)
ax.set_xlabel('Date', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)

# Rotate x-axis labels for better readability
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Adjust the legend
ax.legend(title='Product')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' column to datetime
data['date'] = pd.to_datetime(data['date'])

# Set the style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axis
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 6))

# Plot: Total sales per product over time
sales_over_time = data.groupby(['date', 'product'])['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Line plot with hue for different products
sns.lineplot(data=sales_over_time, x='date', y='total', hue='product', marker='o', ax=ax)

# Set labels and title
ax.set_title('Total Sales per Product Over Time', fontsize=14)
ax.set_xlabel('Date', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)

# Rotate x-axis labels for better readability
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Adjust the legend
ax.legend(title='Product')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
